title: gdpr.owner.probe
description: Daily liveness probe from stapel-gdpr. Answered with gdpr.owner.alive from the same subscriber that handles gdpr.erasure.requested — until 0.8.0 stapel-video answered no probe at all, so a fleet's owners-health reported `video: alive=false` and its erasures waited on this owner forever while the in-process provider erased fine. Documentation of what is consumed: the authoritative schema is the emitter's, in stapel-gdpr/schemas/emits/.
